pages.title: Facility Capacity Tool
pages.text: The capacity of certain Touhou Little Maid facilities can be expanded, including picnic mats, maid beds, and some recreational facilities. Use the Facility Capacity Tool to change capacity.

pages.title: Shared Facilities
pages.text: Players may sit in the seats of a picnic mat. If a maid occupies that position, she can give it up for the player. You do not need to replace the facility after changing its capacity.
